Title: Army Forge URL Source: https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/armyInfo/q11la9v8h1heu9ja/2/preview Markdown Content: [![Image 1: Home](https://army-forge.opr-cdn.com/app/onepagerules_round_128x128.png)](https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/) Dark Elf Raiders [Studio](https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/studio "Army Forge Studio") [Sign In](https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/auth/signin) GF - Dark Elf Raiders v3.5.3 ## Intro The Dark Elf Raiders are disparate gangs formed by surviving members of the underclass after the Elven Empire collapsed. They rely on the mobility of their small raiding parties and advanced anti-gravity skimmers to make up for their lack of heavy armor. Abandoned by their ruling class during the Robot Legion uprising, handfuls of the Elvish lower classes managed to escape into space. These surviving Elves formed gangs, ready to do whatever it takes to survive. Bitter and distrustful of outsiders, the Gangs persist, taking what they need from outsiders to ensure that they can never be betrayed again. ## About OPR OPR (www.onepagerules.com) is the home of many free games which are designed to be fast to learn and easy to play. This project was made by gamers for gamers and it can only exist thanks to the support of our awesome community. If you want to help us in making more awesome content, you can support us on www.patreon.com/onepagerules Thank you for playing! ## Background Story The Elven Empire was once a dominant power within the Sirius Sector, possessing both advanced psychic abilities and highly advanced technology, and Elven society was strictly governed by a psychically-gifted nobility. As their society developed and spread, the Elven nobility began to develop Robots in order to fulfill more and more roles in their society, until most menial labour was performed by them. More and more Elvish commoners were dragged down into poverty, desperately struggling to survive, even as the Elven Empire itself continued to grow and prosper. After centuries of stability, the rule of the Elven nobility ended suddenly as their robotic servants developed sentience. Conflict broke out, and within hours, social order had collapsed completely as the Elven Empire began to evacuate their home worlds. The evacuation efforts focused on saving the wealthy and influential, whilst transportation within lower class districts were sabotaged, and anyone who attempted to reach an evacuation port without authorization was killed. Desperate to survive, the remaining Elves tried to find a means of escape, knowing they couldn't hide out long on their former home worlds. Some desperate raids led by criminal gangs managed to overpower space port guards and seize evacuation ships or cargo ships, whilst other Elves turned to smuggling rings and other groups that had vessels independent of the Elven military. Taking to the skies in stolen, salvaged and improvised vessels, these Elves would form new gangs and apply their skills to raiding and scavenging in order to survive. The Dark Elves quickly adapted to life as raiders, honing their skills as warriors and scientists, applying the advanced technology of the old Elven Empire in dark and innovative ways. Their knowledge of toxins is almost unparalleled within the Sirius Sector, while their alchemists have also made some unique breakthroughs in reverse engineering the Battle Brother’s gene-mods. Those who receive these enhancements can be made even more powerful than a Prime Brother, though they will be irreparably damaged in mind and body during the process. These innovations have allowed the Dark Elves to survive and prosper in Sirius, even when faced with larger and more united enemies who would prefer to see them hunted down and destroyed. v3.5.3 ## Army-Wide Special Rule Harassing:Once per round, units where all models have this rule may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee. ## Special Rules Agile:Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2” when using Rush/Charge. Harassing Boost:If most models in this unit have Harassing, they may move by up to 6" from Harassing (instead of only 3"). Hit & Run:Once per round, units where all models have this rule may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee. Infiltrate:Counts as having Ambush, but may be deployed anywhere over 3” away from enemy unit. Lacerate:When attacking the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6. Martial Prowess:Once per game, if all models in this unit have this rule, it may be activated even if it had already activated this round (stops being fatigued when activated for the second time). Only up to one third of the units in the army with this rule at the beginning of the game (rounding up) may use it in a single round. Melee Evasion:Enemies get -1 to hit rolls in melee when attacking units where all models have this rule. Melee Shrouding:Enemies get -3" movement to a min. of 6" when trying to charge units where all models have this rule. Melee Slayer:When this model charges, its weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(3) or higher. Piercing Frenzy:Place one marker on this unit when it fully destroys an enemy unit, up to a max. of two markers. For each marker all models with this rule in this unit get AP(+1) on their weapons when attacking until the end of the game. Piercing Hunter:When this model shoots at enemies over 9" away, its weapons get AP(+1). Precision Fighting Mark:Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units get +1 to hit rolls in melee against once (next time the effect would apply). Regeneration Buff:Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Regeneration once (next time the effect would apply). Regenerative Strength:Place one marker on this model when it ignores a wound. When in melee, pick one of its weapons to get +X attacks, where X is the number of markers on it. Strafing:Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and attack it with this weapon as if it was shooting. This weapon may only be used in this way. Unpredictable Fighter:When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead. Vanguard:After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9” of its position. ## Aura Special Rules Courage Aura:This model and its unit get +1 to morale test rolls. Furious Aura:This model and its unit get Furious. Harassing Boost Aura:This model and its unit get Harassing Boost. Melee Shrouding Aura:This model and its unit get Melee Shrouding. Piercing Hunter Aura:This model and its unit get Piercing Hunter. ## Army Spells **Psy-Adrenaline (1):** Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Harassing Boost once (next time the effect would apply). **Snake Bite (1):** Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 2 hits with AP(1) and Lacerate. **Raiding Drugs (2):** Pick up to two enemy units within 18", which friendly units get +1 to hit rolls in melee against once (next time the effect would apply). **Art of Pain (2):** Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 2 hits with AP(2) and Deadly(3). **Fade in the Dark (3):** Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Stealth once (next time the effect would apply). **Holistic Suffering (3):** Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 9 hits. 3 GF -
